meta.title: fr-029
meta.author: farbrausch
meta.description: fr-029 by farbrausch, a Farbrausch V2 song (.v2m format version 5) taken from the release executable of fr-029, carved by v2redux at its own format version (`corpus/embedded/fr029.v2m`). 120 BPM, 2:57, 11 tracks. This is an adapted version, not the original recording: converted by `synth-convert v2m` to the unified synth (instrument kind 64) and imported with `song import`. Against the v2redux reference render it differs by +0.15 dB loudness and at most 0.41 @ 2000 Hz in any octave band (tools/unisynth-parity, A/B listening approved 2026-10-28). No licence is stated: the music belongs to its authors. It is published here as an adapted reference copy while its authors are asked for permission, and is removed at any author's request.
